label: 01 / THE PROBLEM
title:
ONE BOARD.
FEWER MISSED
DETAILS.
body:
Consent forms. Trip fees.
Something else to pack.

The class-group messages,
finally in one place.
narration: School circulars arrive as PDFs, photos, and class-group messages. The small details are easy to lose. NoticeBridge gives a family one noticeboard for what needs doing.

label: 02 / PIN A NOTICE
title:
START WITH
WHAT SCHOOL
SENT HOME.
body:
PDFs, English screenshots,
and pasted text.

Read and check the extracted
wording before continuing.
note: This demo uses local English extraction.
narration: Pin a notice from a PDF, English screenshot, or pasted text. File reading happens in the browser. This walkthrough uses the built-in museum trip sample and local English extraction.

label: 03 / TRACE EVERY STEP
title:
THE TASK.
THE EXACT
WORDS BEHIND IT.
body:
Consent. Payment. Packing.

Each extracted instruction
keeps a clickable source quote.
note: A checklist you can check against the circular.
narration: The circular becomes a checklist: submit the consent form, pay the fee, and pack for the trip. Every extracted step keeps an exact quote from the source.

label: 04 / CHECK THE DATE
title:
READ IT.
CHECK IT.
THEN CONFIRM.
body:
Review the original sentence
before making a reminder.

Unclear dates stay out of the
calendar export until reviewed.
narration: Before creating a reminder, check the date against the highlighted sentence. Confirm it yourself. Missing years and unclear dates stay out of the export until they are reviewed.

label: 05 / THE SCHOOL SENDS AN UPDATE
title:
SAME TRIP.
A DIFFERENT
DEADLINE.
body:
Compare the revised circular.

The previous date is crossed
out. The new date needs
your confirmation again.
narration: Now the school sends a revision. The consent deadline moves from the twenty-fourth to the twenty-seventh of October. NoticeBridge crosses out the old date and asks for confirmation again.

label: 06 / CATCH THE OTHER CHANGE
title:
AND DON'T
FORGET THE
SCHOOL ID.
body:
The packing list changed too.

Changed steps are marked.
Unchanged progress is kept.
The source stays alongside.
narration: The packing list also adds a school ID card. Both changes are marked, while the unchanged payment stays completed. The current circular remains beside the checklist for checking.

label: 07 / HELP AT HOME
title:
ONE PLAN.
MORE WAYS
TO READ IT.
body:
English / Hindi board controls.
Hindi sample instructions.
Device read-aloud.

Imported-notice translation
uses optional AI processing.
narration: English and Hindi board controls, Hindi sample instructions, and device read-aloud help families use the same plan. Full translation of a family's own notices is available through optional AI processing.

label: 08 / PASS THE PLAN ON
title:
ONE SHEET
FOR THE
FAMILY GROUP.
body:
Revised dates and instructions.
Completed steps. Source quotes.

Copy the checklist, save the
text, or print it for home.
note: Keep the version with the instructions.
narration: The family checklist puts the revised instructions, dates, completion state, and original quotes into one sheet. Copy it to a family group, save the text, or print it for home.

label: 09 / THE DATE SHEET
title:
WHAT'S DUE.
AND WHEN.
body:
See the remaining deadlines
together in one place.

Blue: a confirmed date.
Yellow: still needs review.
narration: The date sheet brings the remaining deadlines together. Blue marks confirmed dates. The yellow mark here is a date that still needs review.

label: 10 / TAKE THE DATE WITH YOU
title:
ONLY THE
REMINDERS
YOU CHECKED.
body:
Export confirmed, unfinished
steps as an .ics calendar file.

One all-day consent reminder
is ready in this example.
note: Import the file into your calendar app.
narration: Only unfinished steps with confirmed dates are exported. In this example, the calendar file contains one all-day reminder for the new consent deadline. It can be imported into a calendar app.

label: 11 / KEEP YOUR BOARD
title:
PICK UP
WHERE YOU
LEFT OFF.
body:
Circulars. Progress. Checked dates.
Your name, school, and class.

Download a board backup.
Preview it before restoring.
note: Saved on this device. Portable as a file.
narration: The board is saved on this device. Download a backup to move circulars, progress, and checked dates to another device. Restoring shows a preview before replacing the current board.

label: 12 / NOTICEBRIDGE
title:
TRACE IT.
CATCH THE UPDATE.
SHARE THE PLAN.
body:
A school circular becomes
a clear next step at home.

Working prototype.
Source code and setup.
narration: NoticeBridge connects a school circular to the next step at home. Trace the instruction. Catch the revision. Share the plan. The source code and setup are available on GitHub.
